d: On behalf of Zimmermann, we are hiring for a Assistant Store Manager to lead the first new flagship store in Dubai!

Zimmermann is one of Australia's leading and most respected fashion designer brands. Zimmermann's ready-to-wear and swim and resort collections are sold through Zimmermann boutiques and high-end retailers both in Australia and internationally. r: Your responsibilities will include driving and maximising sales and striving to provide excellence in client service, inspiring and motivating the team, day-to-day stock management and operations, CRM, visual presentation and creating an elevated and memorable brand experience.

To successfully lead and develop a high performing team that achieves individual and team sales results, builds strong team morale and a positive workplace attitude.

d: Department: International Projects, Energy and Infrastructure

We are looking for an experienced associate to join our International Projects, Energy and Infrastructure team. Based in our Oman office, you will work on a variety of matters with a primary focus on power and water projects, PPP, infrastructure development and oil & gas work.
We work with a mix of domestic and international clients and the role would also involve working with members of the wider Projects, Energy and Infrastructure team in the region.
Our busy team deals with a broad range of energy and infrastructure work and there are excellent prospects for career development for the right candidate.

3-5 PQE lawyer with experience gained at a reputable firm
Excellent academic record with a law degree, ideally from a common law jurisdiction
Previous experience in the Omani market
Proven ability to take on responsibility and manage files proactively
Flexibility, positivity and an ability to work effectively in a close-knit office
Willing to travel for meetings around the GCC
Interest in assisting with marketing and business development
Fluent Arabic and English – written and spoken
Can do, hardworking and flexible approach
Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and commercially focused advice.
Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters concurrently, often under time pressure, while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail
Proven ability to prioritise competing demands and adapt to changing deadlines or client needs in a fast-paced, project-driven environment.
Ability and enthusiasm to undertake business development.
Interacts well with people at all levels
Strong case and time management skills
r: Working with developers and procurers of energy and infrastructure projects in Oman and elsewhere in the GC
Managing large and complex transactions under the supervision of partners in Oman and the GC

Building, maintaining and developing client relationships.
Providing key client training seminars and presentations

The Prep Cook 2 is responsible for supporting the daily food preparation and production requirements of the Staff Cafeteria.

This role ensures that high standards of food quality, hygiene, and presentation are maintained while assisting in the preparation of meals for employees. The Prep Cook 2 works closely with the culinary team to deliver efficient and timely service in accordance with company standards and food safety regulations.
q: Previous experience in a kitchen or food preparation role, preferably within a hotel, restaurant, or staff cafeteria environment.
Basic knowledge of food preparation techniques, food safety, and kitchen hygiene practices.
Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment while maintaining quality standards.
Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
Ability to follow recipes, instructions, and standard operating procedures.
Ability to stand for extended periods and perform physically demanding tasks, including lifting and carrying supplies.
Flexibility to work shifts, weekends, and public holidays as required.
Basic understanding of HACCP and food safety regulations is preferred.
Culinary qualification or relevant vocational training is an advantage.
Positive attitude, willingness to learn, and commitment to maintaining high standards of service and cleanliness.
r: Prepare ingredients for cooking, including washing, peeling, cutting, chopping, and portioning food items.
Assist in the preparation and cooking of daily staff meals according to established recipes and menu requirements.
Ensure food is prepared, stored, and served following food safety and hygiene standards.
Maintain appropriate stock levels by reporting shortages and assisting with inventory control.
Properly label, date, and store food products following FIFO (First In, First Out) procedures.
Maintain cleanliness and organization of kitchen workstations, equipment, and storage areas.
Assist with receiving and storing deliveries according to company standards.
Minimize food waste through proper handling, storage, and utilization of ingredients.
Support the culinary team during busy service periods and special events as required.
Follow all health, safety, and sanitation procedures at all times.
Maintain a positive and cooperative working relationship with colleagues and supervisors.
Perform other duties as assigned by the Chef de Partie, Sous Chef, or Executive Chef.

d: Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions-Core (MCAPS) accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

The Customer & Commercial Success (CCS) organization, an organization within MCAPS-Core, is the connected engine that turns Microsoft’s commercial strategy into execution at scale — making it simpler and faster for the field to win for every customer, in every segment, region, and role. The organization brings together planning, landing, execution excellence, services portfolio and delivery, and field activation across Account Team Unit, Specialist Team Unit, and Customer Support Unit to accelerate customer value, drive growth, and strengthen the end-to-end experience across every customer moment.

We are looking for a Presales and Delivery Excellence Cloud Solution Architect (CSA) for the Support for Mission Critical (SfMC), a team within Microsoft, part of CCS, that provides solution-specific expertise designed to drive resiliency and optimum performance of a customer’s most important solutions. Presales and Delivery Excellence CSAs in SfMC guide customer journeys to the cloud, readying them to innovate with AI, and providing thought leadership by constructively challenging customer thinking. You will enable customers to achieve their business objectives by positioning innovative proactive services, applying knowledge of the customer's situation and leveraging subject matter expertise, IP, industry/market insights and a deep understanding of customer success, ensuring solution quality and reliability. This role is flexible in that you can work up to 100% from home.
